checkpoint: From Route 10's Pokemon Center through Rock Tunnel (pokefirered RockTunnel_1F, RockTunnel_B1F map.json and scripts.inc) to Route 10 south of it. The save is on Route 10 by the tunnel's south mouth: the save card's places don't include Rock Tunnel.

The tunnel's north mouth (8, 19) is reached from the Center through the tree (10, 20), cut from below; Heidi (9, 27) sees rows 28..29 below the trees and is left. Two single steps west then put the player below the mouth on (8, 20).

Every floor tile of the tunnel has wild encounters, which are run from (the table has no step that uses a Repel), so the legs end on walls, ladders or someone standing still, which the walker holds again after a battle. An open leg (two tiles or more, not to a wall) is followed only by legs a tile of error in it can't send astray.
Nine trainers stand where the way can't go round them. The others (1F Lucas, Oliver, Ariana, Leah; B1F Eric, Steve) are walked round.
1F Ashton (27, 10) looks west over (24..26, 10), the only way south from the mouth's room: stepped into from (24, 9).
B1F Winston (29, 35) looks south over the south passage (29, 36..38): stepped into from (32, 37), after the leg down column 33 to the wall and a tile back.
B1F Martha (15, 33) looks east over (16..17, 33), the corridor north: stepped into from (17, 34), the wall east of row 34.
B1F Allen (36, 11) looks south over (36, 12..14), the way west to the ladder (33, 3): stepped into from (38, 12), below the wall.

1F Lenny (7, 5) looks south over (7, 6..9), the way east from the ladder (4, 2): stepped into from (6, 9), the end of column 6. The way on to the ladder (20, 13) keeps west of Lucas's line (16..19, 17): down column 11, up column 14 to row 16.
B1F Sofia (11, 15) looks south over (11, 16..19), the way west: stepped into along row 16 from (12..14, 16).
B1F Dudley (5, 11) looks south over (5, 12..15): stepped into from (8, 15) along row 15.

B1F Cooper (2, 6) looks around (sight 2) by the ladder (2, 3): the leg up column 1 to the wall (1, 2) passes him on (1, 6); if he looks west, story_interrupts() fights him and the leg is held on to its wall, as Mt. Moon's Grunt in 00.13.
1F Dana (26, 28) looks south over (26, 29..31), the only way west to the south mouth: stepped into along row 31 from (27..29, 31).

Unverified on the console: Rock Tunnel is dark without Flash, and the overworld, fade, dialog and battle detectors haven't been measured under its darkness (~/FRLGLab/notes/2026-11-09-0028-dark-measure.md). Every step from rock_tunnel_1f to route10_south depends on them.
The corner (11, 35), wall north and rock west, finds the player from any of (11..14, 35) after a battle; east to the wall (19, 35) did not (console B, 2026-11-09 13:35: found 5 tiles off).
